name: Rose quartz
definition: uncut pink quartz specimen (rough chunk, tumbled stone, slab, sphere, freeform); a faceted or cabochon rose quartz is under F6.5 when attested.

name: Smoky quartz
definition: uncut brown to grey-black quartz specimen (point, cluster, tumbled stone, polished piece, on or off matrix).

name: Citrine
definition: uncut yellow to orange quartz specimen (point, cluster, tower, polished piece); a faceted or cabochon citrine is under F6.5 when attested.
